name: Schelling's line: cluster size against neighborhood
description: Schelling's line (70 people, at least half alike wanted) counting from one to six neighbors on each side. Schelling: four on each side gives groups "of about twelve"; three gives "a mean of 7 or 8 per cluster". Measured (release, seeds 1–20, recorded 2026-09-29), mean cluster size at round 50: 4.0, 6.3, 8.4, 10.5, 11.9 and 13.3 for one to six neighbors on each side.
